fields.label: Enable Cloudflare R2
fields.description: When enabled, every new attachment is uploaded to R2 and removed from the server disk.

fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: Cloudflare dashboard → R2 Object Storage → Account Details.

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: Leave empty unless the bucket was created with a jurisdiction.

fields.label: Bucket Name
fields.description: Bucket for private files (and public files unless a Public Bucket is set).

fields.label: Access Key ID
fields.description: R2 → Manage API Tokens → Object Read & Write, scoped to your bucket(s).

fields.label: Public Files
fields.description: Public files are served straight from Cloudflare's CDN through a domain connected to the bucket. Private files are always served through Frappe with a permission check and a short-lived signed URL.

fields.label: Public Base URL
fields.description: e.g. https://files.erp.supagigs.cloud (R2 → bucket → Settings → Custom Domains). Leave empty to serve public files through Frappe too.

fields.label: Public Bucket (optional)
fields.description: Recommended when using a public domain: a separate bucket for public files keeps private files unreachable from the internet.

fields.label: Folder (key prefix)
fields.description: Optional prefix for all objects, e.g. the site name, when several sites share a bucket.

fields.label: Keep Local for DocTypes
fields.description: One DocType per line. Files attached to these stay on the server disk (same behaviour as frappe_s3_attachment). site_config key ignore_r2_upload_for_doctype is also honoured.

fields.label: Multipart Threshold (MB)
fields.description: Files larger than this are uploaded in parts through the S3 multipart API (no 300 MB dashboard limit).

fields.label: Delete From R2 When File Is Deleted
Keep Deleted Files For (days)
fields.description: Deleted files are moved to the trash prefix and purged by a daily job after this many days. 0 deletes immediately.

fields.label: Migration Help
fields.options: Migrations run in the background in batches and can be re-run safely; already migrated files are skipped. File records, Attach / Attach Image fields on every DocType and Single DocType settings are re-pointed automatically. See the Migration Log for per-file results.

fields.label: Also Rewrite Links Inside Text Fields
fields.description: Updates image and file links embedded in Text Editor, HTML, Markdown and Long Text fields (notes, emails, web pages). Slower on large sites.

fields.label: Move R2 Files Back to Server
fields.description: Exit path before uninstalling. Disable R2 first.

fields.label: Load From S3 Attachment App
fields.description: Copies bucket, region and keys from the S3 File Attachment settings. You can edit them afterwards.

fields.label: Keep S3 Originals For (days)
fields.description: After migration the S3 copy is kept this long (rollback window), then deleted by a daily job. 0 keeps it forever.
